runs.narr: OUT at Q2 after Q1 IN (a North American railcar lessor of about 101,000 cars with its own builder). The Leasing Group, 84% of FY2021 to FY2025 segment profit, decides: a standing castle that protects only ordinary returns, pre-tax operating profit on its own assets 6.2% mean FY2017 to FY2025 (5.5% with the FY2020 impairment), 4.4% to 4.9% after tax against a 5.43% Treasury, equity returns of 9% to 14% made by debt of about 4.6 times equity, lease rates falling in the downturns; GATX 4.6%, Greenbrier 4.8% unlevered after-tax on assets, FreightCar America negative (rivals a CONVENTION of the run); Rail Products a commodity-type builder at 6.4% mean margin and half its capacity. Facts after the stop: assets flat over ten years, equity $3.9B to $1.1B, debt $5.2B with $1.7B due 2028; integrity facts recorded, not judged: the 2025 bonus at 178% of target on PBT including a non-cash $194.2M gain (below target without it), a second non-cash $132M gain anchoring Q2 2026 EPS, EPS guidance, unpriced buybacks. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: value -$34.91 to $4.26 all-equity against $25.22, no case earning the floor; fair -$36.13 all-equity, $8.74 equity-only, not armed. Framework gaps for the operator: a lessor's fleet spending and sale proceeds in owner cash; no measure for ordinary returns under heavy gearing; odd-window halves; the (f) cut's own test.
